name: io.github.stimQQ/apimodels-mcp
title: apimodels
description: Image, video, chat and speech models with one account — local (npx) or hosted with OAuth sign-in.

environmentVariables.name: APIMODELS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your sk_… API key from https://apimodels.app/console/api-keys

environmentVariables.name: APIMODELS_WAIT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Default wait_seconds for generate_image / generate_video / text_to_speech / get_task before they hand back a task id. Default 50 (Codex aborts tool calls at 60 s).

environmentVariables.name: APIMODELS_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Deprecated: same wait in milliseconds, honoured for old configs.
